rdf:Description.skos:definition: The standard abbreviations (pick-list codes) of AGS 4.2.0 for headings of data type PA, one collection per heading. Only entries with status Approved, Accepted, Deprecated are included.
rdf:Description.skos:historyNote: Generated by ags-rdf 0.1.0 from the AGS 4.2.0 data dictionary JSON (AGS4/abbr4.json) published in https://gitlab.com/AGS-DFWG-Web/ASG4 at commit 710b1f080972 (2026-10-08). The JSON files are treated as the authoritative source; values are only cleaned of formatting artefacts.
